briefdescription.para: Get handle to requested power node by "only" Node INDEX.

detaileddescription.para:
PwrIndex
Power Node Index
Pointer to requested XPm_Power, NULL otherwise
Requires ONLY Node Index Caller should be careful while using this function as it skips the checks for validating the class, subclass and type of the power before and after retrieving the node from the database. Use this only where it is absolutely necessary, otherwise use XPmPower_GetById() which is more strict and requires 'complete' Node ID for retrieving the handle.

inbodydescription.para: Here UseCount 0 with state ON indicates that power is ON (CDO is loaded) but no child node is requested. So power parent needs to be requested since power node UseCount is changing from 0 to 1

briefdescription.para: Read the current software state of a power node.

parameterdescription.para: Complete power node ID to look up.
Non-NULL output pointer receiving the node state when found. It is left unchanged when the lookup fails.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS when the power node is found, or XST_FAILURE otherwise.
